shared_elements: limbs/arms held in a bent posture
justification: Both depict an upright anthropomorphic figure with head and bent limbs, but that is a near-universal subject and the correspondence stops there: A is a flat, silhouetted, linear painted human in profile-legged striding pose surrounded by small schematic animal and sign motifs, whereas B is a compact three-dimensional composite figure with a crouched body and a large ridged element above the head, with no accompanying secondary motifs. The rendering conventions differ entirely — thin solid outline drawing versus blocky carved volumes with incised hatching — so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
